text:
samir: Trying the new quickstart in a minimal CI image. `redwoodctl login` dies while trying to save the profile.

samir: Exact output: 
```
error: could not persist profile: open /workspace/.config/redwood/profiles.json: permission denied
failed to replace file atomically: rename /workspace/.config/redwood/profiles.json.tmp -> /workspace/.config/redwood/profiles.json: invalid cross-device link
```

samir: Repo is bind-mounted from the host and owned by uid 1000; the container process runs as uid 1002. This used to work.

leigh: That EXDEV on rename is classic when temp file is on a different FS. Workarounds are known (set XDG_CONFIG_HOME to /tmp or write under /tmp) but they're not in the quickstart so students/engineers hit a hard stop.

tara: Also saw device-code auth flakiness in workshops. TTL=60s. People switching windows to paste the code hit `device code expired` and the CLI exits without a clear retry command.

samir: Minimal repro Dockerfile I used: 
```
FROM debian:12
RUN useradd -m -u 1002 runner
USER runner
WORKDIR /workspace
COPY . /workspace
ENV HOME=/home/runner
CMD ["/bin/sh","-c","redwoodctl login --profile quickstart"]
```

dev-rel-bot: (automated) failed job #88: onboarding-quickstart  auth: write error to config. See internal logs.

nico: Thanks for the report. Two quick DX proposals: (A) automatically detect rename errors (EXDEV) or EACCES and fall back to a safe-write path (copy+unlink or write-in-place) with a short WARN that includes an exact remediation command; (B) add CLI flags for ephemeral/CI flows: `--in-memory` (do not persist; print token), `--persist /path` (explicit write path), `--no-atomic` (force safe-write), and `--device-ttl-seconds` plus `--headless-token /path` for CI pre-seeded tokens.

leigh: For the remediation text, make it one grep-friendly line: "config not writable; try `export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/rw && redwoodctl login` or use `--in-memory` for ephemeral CI". Also return a distinct exit code for recoverable auth/write problems so CI scripts can detect and retry.

tara: For device flow UX: detect interactive terminals and extend TTL; for headless, print `--headless-token` instructions and a retry loop with exponential backoff instead of immediate hard fail on expiry. Also emit a clickable device URL when TERM supports hyperlinks.

samir: Short-term we patched onboarding to export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/rw in CI. Long-term an automatic fallback would remove a ton of friction.

nico: I'll open a GH issue with the repro and suggested UX text, and add a unit test that stubs os.Rename to return EXDEV/EACCES and asserts we log the one-line hint and switch to safe-write.

samir: Thanks  leaving the tiny Dockerfile and a shell repro in devex/onboarding-repros. TL;DR: atomic rename + bind/NFS mounts + short device TTL = flaky onboarding; workaround: set XDG_CONFIG_HOME or use `--in-memory`/`--persist` flags once available.
